g.text: Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE -- Ex: Admin, Manager, Technician, Standard
Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE -- Ex: Porto, Lisboa
Code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, -- Ex: P1, P2, P3, P4
Description VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL -- Ex: Urgente, Alta, Média, Baixa
Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE -- Ex: Open, Assigned, Pending, WIP, Resolved, Closed
Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE -- Ex: Open, On Hold, In Progress, Done, Closed
LocationsID INT NULL, -- Pode ser nulo para utilizadores padrão
CONSTRAINT FK_Users_Roles FOREIGN KEY (RolesID) REFERENCES Roles(RolesID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Users_Locations FOREIGN KEY (LocationsID) REFERENCES Locations(LocationsID)
ReferenceCode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- Ex: SUP001, SVC001
OpenDate DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE()
CONSTRAINT FK_Tickets_Priorities FOREIGN KEY (PrioritiesID) REFERENCES Priorities(PrioritiesID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Tickets_Statuses FOREIGN KEY (TicketStatusesID) REFERENCES TicketStatuses(TicketStatusesID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Tickets_CreatedBy FOREIGN KEY (CreatedByID) REFERENCES Users(UsersID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Tickets_AssignedTo FOREIGN KEY (AssignedToID) REFERENCES Users(UsersID)
TechnicianID INT NOT NULL, -- Campo transferido para aqui
ReferenceCode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- Ex: INT001
CONSTRAINT FK_Tasks_Tickets FOREIGN KEY (TicketsID) REFERENCES Tickets(TicketsID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Tasks_Technician FOREIGN KEY (TechnicianID) REFERENCES Users(UsersID)
CONSTRAINT FK_Tasks_Statuses FOREIGN KEY (TaskStatusesID) REFERENCES TaskStatuses(TaskStatusesID)
ReferenceID INT NOT NULL, -- Pode ser ID do Ticket ou da Task
Content TEXT NULL, -- Caminho do ficheiro ou texto do comentário
CreatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE()
CONSTRAINT FK_Attachments_Users FOREIGN KEY (UsersID) REFERENCES Users(UsersID)
